knowledgeBase.title: Campus Wi-Fi quick checks
knowledgeBase.summary: Reconnect safely before reporting a network issue.
knowledgeBase.body: Turn Wi-Fi off and on, forget and rejoin the campus network, then confirm whether the problem affects one device or everyone nearby. Never include your password in a report.

knowledgeBase.title: Projector is not displaying
knowledgeBase.summary: Check input, cable, and room controls.
knowledgeBase.body: Confirm the projector is powered on, select the correct HDMI input, reseat the cable, and try duplicate-display mode. Report the room number and any light or error code you see.

knowledgeBase.title: Water leak safety
knowledgeBase.summary: Protect people first and report the exact source.
knowledgeBase.body: Keep people away from wet electrical equipment. If safe, identify the closest room or fixture and add a wide photo. For rapidly flowing water, contact campus security as well as submitting a high-impact report.

knowledgeBase.title: Lost campus ID or bank card
knowledgeBase.summary: Block access and payments before searching.
knowledgeBase.body: Freeze any bank card immediately. Contact campus services to suspend a lost ID, then create a lost-item report without posting the full card number publicly.
